name: ctc-forced-aligner
role: Align known text to audio with a CTC model, word-timed JSON
notes: 2026-11-27: deferred, no fixture. The default model MahmoudAshraf/mms-300m-1130-forced-aligner is CC-BY-NC-4.0 (Hugging Face metadata) and model.safetensors is 1.26 GB, so it fails both the licence and size rules for a worker fixture. Revisit if a freely licensed alignment checkpoint under 1 GB is confirmed to work with the tool, or if the person approves the NC download for private use.
2026-11-27: lead said 1.0.2 on PyPI; repository HEAD 277720f (2026-11-24) is newer and the README installs from git. Code licence confirmed BSD-2-Clause by GitHub.

Claim planned if revived: align a known transcript to macOS say speech, word starts in order within a predeclared tolerance; compare with echogarden and whisperx (whisperx-word-timing: 10/10 within 0.20 s).
summary: Python CLI and library that aligns a known transcript to audio with a CTC model at word, sentence or character level and writes JSON segments. It needs no pronunciation dictionary and covers 1,130 languages. The default model is non-commercial licensed and 1.26 GB, which limits use.
use_when: Time a known script to narration in many languages, no dictionary; non-commercial weights
avoid_when: Need commercial-safe weights out of the box: the default model is CC-BY-NC-4.0
Need transcription as well as alignment: use whisperx
license: BSD-2-Clause (code); default model weights CC-BY-NC-4.0, checked separately

install.macos: pip install git+https://github.com/MahmoudAshraf97/ctc-forced-aligner.git in a venv; needs FFmpeg; model downloads required

assessment.rationale: Code is BSD-2-Clause and the repository was pushed 2026-11-24, but the default weights are CC-BY-NC-4.0 and 1.26 GB, so no fixture was run. Kept as a candidate with the deferral reason recorded.
